validation.summary: The candidate is extremely close to the reference and implements the complex scroll animations (GSAP converging lines, sticky sections) exceptionally well. The component structure is clean and highly editable via the CONFIG object. A few minor styling adjustments are needed, specifically adding the missing background block to the Clinical Support section and tweaking a color transition.
strengths: Excellent implementation of the complex GSAP scroll-bound animations, particularly the converging SVG lines.
Clean, configuration-driven component structure makes the template highly reusable and editable.
Smart, simplified approach to the Hero UI animation using React state and CSS transitions.
Sticky scrolling behavior in the Clinical Support section works perfectly.

issues.title: Missing background block in Clinical Support section
issues.observed: The left column containing the scrolling list of specialties has a transparent/white background.
issues.expected: The left column should have a light green background block with rounded corners, as specified in the requirements ('Left column: Large serif text, light green background block') and visible in the reference video.
issues.fix_instructions: In the `ClinicalSupport` component, add `bg-light-green rounded-[3rem] p-12 md:p-16` to the `div` that wraps the scrolling text list.

issues.title: Incorrect background color transition in Problem/Solution
issues.observed: The background color in the Problem/Solution section transitions to `#BDE3C0` (light green).
issues.expected: The background color should transition to `#A3D2A6` (medium green) as per the animation requirements.
issues.fix_instructions: In the `ProblemSolution` component's GSAP timeline, update the `backgroundColor` target value from `"#BDE3C0"` to `"#A3D2A6"`.

patch_instructions: In the `ClinicalSupport` component, locate the left column container: `<div className="py-12 md:py-20">`. Change it to `<div className="py-12 md:py-20 bg-light-green rounded-[3rem] px-8 md:px-16">` to add the missing background block.

In the `ProblemSolution` component, locate the GSAP timeline animation for the background color: `tl.to(sectionRef.current, { backgroundColor: "#BDE3C0", duration: 2 }, "<");`. Change `"#BDE3C0"` to `"#A3D2A6"` to match the specified design token.
